freestanding-parallette-weight-shift.label: Both grips stay; shift left two seconds, centre, right two seconds, centre
freestanding-parallette-weight-shift.camera: Front-oblique full-body view exposes both fixed hand-to-bar contacts, straight elbows and both lateral stack shifts. The arrows indicate direction only, not measured forces.

freestanding-parallette-one-hand-light-b.label: Bias support left for three seconds, centre, then right; light hand stays touching
phases: Bias left; right hand stays touching
Bias right; left hand stays touching
freestanding-parallette-one-hand-light-b.camera: Front-oblique view shows both hands continuously on their separate bars and the larger support bias in both directions. The light hand never lifts. The drawing does not measure unloading or demonstrate a one-arm hold.

freestanding-parallette-hspu-eccentric.label: Four-second lower to standard depth; fold and land directly, without pressing up
phases: Four-second negative to standard crown depth
Feet land outside bars; no ascent
freestanding-parallette-hspu-eccentric.camera: Full-body side view shows an unloaded crown at the standard bar-top plane and a direct bent-arm feet-to-floor exit. The shoulders never rise between the scored bottom and grounded landing. One-way reset never plays the negative backwards.

partial-freestanding-parallette-hspu.label: Lower to the fixed halfway crown marker, press, settle two seconds, exit
partial-freestanding-parallette-hspu.camera: Side view keeps the fixed halfway crown marker visibly above the separate standard bar-top plane. The crown reaches the halfway height, then a complete concentric and two-second top follow. No external support is shown.

freestanding-parallette-hspu.label: Standard crown depth, press to lockout, settle two seconds, exit
freestanding-parallette-hspu.camera: Side view shows the crown at the standard bar-top plane without touching the pad, followed by the complete unassisted press, settled top and separate grounded exit. This is not deficit range.

deficit-freestanding-parallette-hspu.label: Use only the reviewed below-bar depth, press, settle two seconds, exit
deficit-freestanding-parallette-hspu.camera: Side view uses taller bars and a clearly below-bar pad with unloaded crown. Only this illustrated reviewed depth is demonstrated; the separate current deeper-exit setup must match. Standard depth cannot substitute.
